stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks you to turn the phone to landscape when it needs it.
stumbles.why: Seems contradictory: if rotation is locked in portrait, turning the phone to landscape wouldn't rotate the display. It's unclear how the game shows in landscape or whether I should unlock.

stumbles.quote: Tilt the top of the phone away from you to accelerate.
stumbles.why: Ambiguous in landscape, which is how you hold the phone while driving. It's unclear which edge is the 'top' once the phone is turned sideways.

stumbles.quote: the game takes the phone's tilt at that moment as straight ahead.
stumbles.why: Unclear whether this calibrates only steering or also the accelerate/brake angle. It also doesn't say what 'straight ahead' means for the forward/back tilt, or that I can't recalibrate later.

point: To play, open the page on a motion-sensor phone, pick track, laps and difficulty in portrait, start, switch to landscape, then steer by tilting left/right and accelerate or brake by tilting away from or towards you, relative to the pose you hold when the lights go out.
